# The demo content packages

This page is for developers, administrators and website creators who want to know what content a `sevenx_multisite`
installation starts with, or why a `_clean` installation looks the way it does. It answers: what the two content
packages hold, how they are organized, and how they differ.

## Contents

1. [The two packages](#the-two-packages)
2. [The 31 ng content classes](#the-31-ng-content-classes)
3. [The content objects](#the-content-objects)
4. [What the clean package keeps](#what-the-clean-package-keeps)
5. [Binary files and remote ids](#binary-files-and-remote-ids)
6. [Files that ship but are not installed](#files-that-ship-but-are-not-installed)

## The two packages

| | `sevenx_multisite_democontent` | `sevenx_multisite_democontent_clean` |
|---|---|---|
| Summary | MultiSite demo content | MultiSite site structure without demo content |
| Type | `contentobject`, `install_type="install"` | the same |
| Version | number `6.0`, release `15-stable` | the same |
| Class files in `ezcontentclass/` | 31 | the same 31, byte-identical |
| Object files listed in `contentobjects.xml` | 291 | 35 |
| Files in `simplefiles/` | 194 | 6 |
| `<simple-file>` entries in `package.xml` | 314 | 6 |
| Published archive size (6.0.15) | 62669990 bytes | 221174 bytes |
| Required by | `sevenx_multisite` | `sevenx_multisite_clean` |

Both packages have the same `<install>` section: 31 `ezcontentclass` items followed by one `ezcontentobject` item
(`filename="contentobjects"`). Their `<uninstall>` section lists the same items. The `contentobjects.xml` of both names
two top nodes, `media-n-940` "Bold Agency" and `media-n-939` "Fit & Healthy", and the siteaccesses `site` and
`admin`.

| `ng_news` | News | Netgen | 18 |
| `ng_person` | Person | Netgen | 8 |
| `ng_recipe` | Recipe | Netgen | 21 |
| `ng_shortcut` | Shortcut | Netgen | 6 |
| `ng_site_info` | Site info | Netgen | 20 |
| `ng_topic` | Topic | Netgen | 7 |
| `ng_video` | NG Video | Netgen | 15 |

Several datatypes these classes use come from extensions: `eztags` (eztags), `ngenhancedlink` (`exp_enhanced_link`),
`sckenhancedselection` (`enhancedselection2`), `ngclasslist` (`ngclasslist`) and `xrowmetadata`. That is why the
installer's `preInstall()` makes the settings of every listed extension part of the run before any package is
installed (`activateSiteExtensionSettings()`); without it "the datatypes of enhancedselection2 and ngclasslist were
'not found'", as the comment in the installer puts it.

## The content objects

The 291 object files of the full package, counted by the `ezremote:class_identifier` of each file:

| Class | Objects | Class | Objects |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | 67 | `ng_topic` | 4 |
| `ng_article` | 27 | `ng_component_lead` | 4 |
| `ng_video` | 25 | `folder` | 4 |
| `ng_recipe` | 19 | `ng_person` | 3 |
| `ng_container` | 19 | `ng_news` | 3 |
| `ng_shortcut` | 12 | `ng_job_position` | 3 |
| `ng_logo` | 12 | `ng_site_info`, `ng_lead_form`, `ng_gallery`, `ng_frontpage`, `ng_contact_form` | 2 each |
| `ng_component_features` | 11 | `ng_component_quote`, `ng_component_logos`, `ng_category` | 2 each |
| `ng_landing_page` | 10 | `review`, `product`, `ng_audio`, `file`, `comment` | 1 each |
| `ng_blog_post` | 9 | | |
| `ng_accordion_item` | 8 | | |
| `ng_component_hero`, `ng_component_about` | 6 each | | |
| `ng_menu_item` | 7 | | |
| `ng_banner` | 6 | | |
| `ng_htmlbox` | 5 | | |

Among them are a guided tour, the `ng_landing_page` "Tour" (remote id `showcase-s1-tour`) with twelve stops
(`object-media-o-showcase-s1-stop-01.xml` to `-12.xml`), and a "Test Product" (`product`) with one `review` and one
`comment`. The translations are mostly `eng-US`; 51 object files also carry a `ger-DE` translation: mostly the Bold
Agency pages, job positions, components and forms, plus the footer links, which the German `bold_ger` siteaccess
shows.

## What the clean package keeps

The 35 objects of `sevenx_multisite_democontent_clean` are the frame of both sites without articles, recipes, videos
or images:

| Kind | Objects |
|---|---|
| Home pages | "Fit & Healthy" and "Bold Agency" (`ng_frontpage`) |
| Site settings | "Fit & Healthy site info - [SITEINFO]" and "Bold Agency - [SITEINFO]" (`ng_site_info`) |
| Forms | "Contact" (`ng_contact_form`), "Lead form" and "Job application form" (`ng_lead_form`) |
| Legal pages | "Privacy Policy" and "Cookie Policy" for each site (four `ng_article`) |
| Media library folders | "Media", "Images", "Files", "Footer links" (`folder`) |
| Containers | Banners, Clients & Partners, Components and its six component folders, Configuration, Forms, Menu items, Videos |
| Footer links | Cart, Edit, Forgot Password, Login, Signup, Sitemap, Tagcloud (`ng_menu_item`) |

The layouts in `sevenx_themes_media/share/db_data.dba` still name the demo content that the clean package leaves out.
The post-install fix removes those references instead of letting them point at whatever object received the same id;
see [Post-install fixes](post-install-fixes.md).

## Binary files and remote ids

Images, files, audio and video are stored once in `simplefiles/` under short hashed names (`simplefiles/4d7492d6.jpg`)
and referenced from `<simple-file>` entries with their original path, so one binary can serve several references
(commit of 2026-09-13: "store each binary once instead of once per reference, so the built archives fit the
distribution size limit"). In the full package these are 135 `.jpg`, 5 `.jpeg`, 29 `.png`, 22 `.svg`, one `.mp4`, one
`.wav` and one `.txt` file, about 61 MB unpacked.

Every object and node carries a remote id of the form `media-o-<name or number>` and `media-n-<number>`. The installer
relies on them: node ids differ between installations, remote ids do not. The home nodes are found as `media-n-939`
(Fit & Healthy) and `media-n-940` (Bold Agency), the menus and legal pages through the package node ids the post-install
fix maps.

## Files that ship but are not installed

None any more. Until 2026-10-19 the full package also carried 113 files named
`object-media-o-<n>.xml.bak.eztagsdedupe` and `object-media-o-<n>.xml.bak.tagorder` in `ezcontentobject/`, backup
copies that `packages/build.sh` packed with everything else. Nothing read them: `contentobjects.xml` lists only the
`object-*.xml` files, and the post-install code looks for files matching `object-media-o-*.xml` and
`^object-.+\.xml$`. They were removed from the source repository, `build.sh` and `bin/pack.sh` now leave `*.bak` and
`*.bak.*` files out of every package, and the rebuilt archive (62,314,497 bytes) is on the package server.
